BSA Scrambler 350, Bobber 350, Thunderbolt 350 Debut At EICMA

KS
By Kabir Sharma Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist • via Rushlane.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Rushlane.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • Aiming to strengthen its presence in European markets, especially the UK, BSA Motorcycles has showcased three new bikes at EICMA 2026.
  • The newly added Bantam Scrambler 350, Bantam Bobber 350 and what looks like the production-spec version of Thunderbolt 350.
  • These will primarily target beginners, lifestyle riders and urban commuters.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist

Bharat NCAP Safety Standards & Indian Road Readiness

In India's rapidly evolving automotive landscape, crashworthiness and real-world durability are driving consumer purchase decisions like never before. As reported by Rushlane.com, indigenous automakers like Tata Motors and Mahindra are setting global safety benchmarks while optimizing suspension and ground clearance for unpredictable road conditions.

Big Picture: Upcoming monthly FADA retail delivery reports and Bharat NCAP rating scorecards will reveal which domestic models capture mass-market dominance.

Aiming to strengthen its presence in European markets, especially the UK, BSA Motorcycles has showcased three new bikes at EICMA 2026. The newly added Bantam Scrambler 350, Bantam Bobber 350 and what looks like the production-spec version of Thunderbolt 350. These will primarily target beginners, lifestyle riders and urban commuters.

📌 The Core Development

These could be available in showrooms in European markets in 2027, although a specific launch date has not been revealed. It is not certain if these will be launched in India. BSA has also introduced new colour options for its existing bikes in Europe.

This retro-styled bike is suitable for everyday urban commutes, while also having the capability for light off-roading. BSA Bantam Scrambler 350 has a circular headlamp, a raised front fender, fork gaiters and a circular instrument pod. Other key highlights include a classic fuel tank design, racing style side number plates and a slightly upswept exhaust. The bike uses a single piece seat with quilted stitching, which enhances the retro aesthetic.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

Colour options include Black, Green and Grey. BSA Bantam Scrambler 350 has 19-inch front and 17-inch rear wire spoke wheels. These are paired with versatile knobby tyres capable of handling a variety of riding conditions. The bike has disc brakes at both ends, 320 mm at the front and 240 mm at the rear.

Seat height of 812 mm seems suitable for most applications. Kerb weight of the bike is 184 kg. Powering the BSA Bantam Scrambler 350 is a 334cc engine, which generates 29 hp and 30 Nm of torque. This unit is engineered for a more responsive throttle and delivers strong torque across the low and mid-range. This engine is relatively lightweight, helping improve the bike’s power to weight ratio.

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

This bike has a circular headlamp, road biased tyres, a teardrop shaped fuel tank and a rider-only seat with quilted stitching. Other features include a wide handlebar, bar-end mirrors and a broad rear fender. Bantam Bobber 350 has a standard variant and a SP variant with premium features. The standard variant uses 41 mm telescopic forks at the front and a preload adjustable monoshock unit at the rear.

🔮 Strategic Outlook & What Lies Ahead

The bike has alloy wheels, 18-inch at the front and 17-inch at the rear. Braking setup comprises 320 mm and 240 mm discs at the front and rear, respectively. Dual-channel ABS is offered as standard. Users can expect optimal control and handling with a low seat height of 742 mm. Kerb weight of the bike is 189 kg.

For now, the Bantam Bobber 350 has been showcased in a single dark red/grey colour option. The Bantam Bobber 350 SP (Special Parts) variant gets exclusive features such as gold-finished USD forks, 16-inch wire-spoke wheels and a wider front tyre. Tech package includes a TFT display. The SP variant was showcased in a single Dark Chrome colour.
